about: Per-unit ammunition (SPEC §10: unit ammo kept, unit fuel removed). Capacity by unit kind, overridden by role or indirect class; one shot volley / one shell uses ammo.per_shot (default 1). CoH3 has no ammo, so these are Burning Front values (decision G; raised ×1.5 on 2026-11-28 after the G-4 time-to-kill report).
